enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with air conditioner on for heatwave relief.
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up to chin. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down slightly. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow again. Lie still.
Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Crack eggs into pan. Turn on stove. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional.
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on uniform. Attend morning meeting. Check patient charts. Administer medication. Assist doctor during rounds. Take patient vitals. Update patient records. Answer phone calls. Consult with colleagues. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Complete paperwork. Clock out. Leave workplace.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Take off shoes. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pause TV. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to living room. Sit down. Resume watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to computer. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Log in. Open browser. Browse websites. Check email. Watch videos. Play games. Chat with friends. Type messages. Scroll. Click. Turn off computer. Stand up.

Walk to bookshelf. Pick up book. Sit on sofa. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Put book down. Pick up phone. Open music app. Select playlist. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Close eyes. Tap foot. Take off headphones. Turn off music.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and preparing for bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Dry off with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with fan on for heatwave relief.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Place hands on chest. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down slightly. Sleep.
